# Radeon Arena

> LLM inference benchmarks measured on AMD Radeon GPUs (vLLM and llama.cpp on ROCm), and an A2A API for the AMD GPU Support Agent, which answers questions about AMD GPUs, ROCm and local LLMs and cites the official AMD ROCm community support FAQ and AMD's public documentation.

The public leaderboard currently shows the Radeon 8060S (Strix Halo), the Radeon AI PRO R9700 and the Radeon PRO W7900. The API takes and returns structured JSON and needs a free account with a verified email address, created with an email code or a GitHub sign-in. Each account can send 30 messages per minute.

## API

- [API Docs](https://radeon-arena.com/docs): authentication, actions, reply types, errors and limits
- [Agent Card](https://radeon-arena.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A JSON-RPC 1.0 endpoint, skills, example requests and sign-up steps
- [Request schema](https://radeon-arena.com/a2a/schemas/request.v1.json): JSON Schema for the data part you send
- [Reply schema](https://radeon-arena.com/a2a/schemas/reply.v1.json): JSON Schema for the data part of every reply

## Benchmarks

- [Strix Halo leaderboard](https://radeon-arena.com/strix/leaderboard): measured results by model, engine and quantization
- [Radeon AI PRO R9700 leaderboard](https://radeon-arena.com/r9700/leaderboard): measured results on one, two and four R9700 cards
- [Radeon PRO W7900 leaderboard](https://radeon-arena.com/w7900/leaderboard): measured results on one and two W7900 cards
- [Recipes](https://radeon-arena.com/strix/recipes): the commands and settings behind each result
- [Submit a benchmark](https://radeon-arena.com/strix/submit): how to contribute results

## Blog

- [A/B test: does the AMD GPU Support Agent help a coding agent deploy a local model?](https://radeon-arena.com/blogs/support-agent-ab-test-windows-strix-halo/): Claude Code deploying Qwen3.8-27B on a Windows Strix Halo laptop, three runs with and three without the support agent; time, tokens and failures on both sides
- [vLLM on AMD Radeon](https://radeon-arena.com/blogs/engine-vllm/): every vLLM result on the board, and vLLM against llama.cpp with the same weights and cards
- [llama.cpp on AMD Radeon](https://radeon-arena.com/blogs/engine-llama-cpp/): every llama.cpp result on the board, and what quantization does to decode speed
- [Blog index](https://radeon-arena.com/blogs): one post per model with all of its measured deployments across devices, engines and weight formats

## 中文

Every page also has a Chinese version under /zh, for example [API 文档](https://radeon-arena.com/zh/docs), [Strix Halo 榜单](https://radeon-arena.com/zh/strix/leaderboard) and [博客](https://radeon-arena.com/zh/blogs). Blog posts have the same slugs in both languages.

## Open source

- [radeon-arena/skills](https://github.com/radeon-arena/skills): twelve single-task agent skills for AMD GPU setup and triage
- [radeon-arena/mcp](https://github.com/radeon-arena/mcp): local MCP servers for support evidence, read-only diagnostics and public ROCm CI status
- [radeon-arena/radeonrun](https://github.com/radeon-arena/radeonrun): containers and recipes used for the benchmarks
